book.title: ROM Rom mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Tukul Guwa tuku saŋgri
Sine Kristus Yesus ndoŋ ulendikeg mbal sine pa tam tuku mine ndakeg.
Sine nu ndoŋ ulendikeg sulumba Tukul Guwa kumnemŋge mineg le nu une tuku saŋgri te-simba muskil kile-tidiŋge siŋmba abo mine maŋau siŋgit.

Sine taŋgo tuku maŋau gisleknu ŋak mingeŋ tukunu tukul pasa nu sine tursiŋge fuguna ta Kuateŋge nu sine turkina sulumba nu nuŋe Kiŋo kukulna le nu kilke mbolok une ŋak taŋgo taŋaŋ mayok ka Kuate tuku nzali dubimba une saukam tuku ŋgarosu kumam tuku pilna. Taŋana le Kuate nu kilke mbolok taŋgombi une tuku saŋgri kume serna.
Ta tuku sine taŋgo tuku maŋau gisleknu kumnemŋge mine ndaka Tukul Guwa tuku nzali kumnemŋge mineg mbal sine tukul pasa am mbolŋge kumumbi mayok kineg.
Nane taŋgo tuku maŋau gisleknu kumnemŋge minig mbal naŋgine wamdus taŋgo tuku wam mbolŋge ndo minig. Tukul Guwa tuku nzali kumnemŋge minig mbal naŋgine wamdus Tukul Guwa tuku wam mbolŋge minig.
Ande nu nuŋe wamdus taŋgo tuku maŋau mbolŋge pilit ta nu ŋgisikamŋgat. Ande nu nuŋe wamdus Tukul Guwa mbolŋge pilit ta nu abo ŋak ŋgamuŋgal mukuk minamŋgat.
Taŋgo tuku maŋau gisleknu kumnemŋge minig mbal nane Kuate tuku ŋgueu minig. Nane Kuate tuku tukul pasa kumnemŋge mine ndakade. Nane siŋka dubiwam fugude.
Nane taŋgo tuku maŋau gisleknu kumnemŋge minig tukunu nane Kuate gare tambim kumuŋ kuga.
Tukul Guwa siŋka tane sinamŋge minit ta tane nu tuku nzali kumnemŋge minig. Tane taŋgo tuku maŋau gisleknu kumnemŋge mine ndakade. Ande nu Kristus tuku Guwa kugatok ta nu Kristus tuku taŋgo kuga.
Tane une maŋau ŋak tukunu ŋgarosu kumam tuku minig ta Kristus nu tane sinamŋge minit le tane tiŋreknu mayok ka ŋgamuŋgal abo tugu ŋak minig.
Yesus kumna le Kuateŋge te-tina ta nuŋe Guwa tane sinamŋge minit. Nu tane sinamŋge minit tukunu nu Kristus Yesus kumna le te-tina taŋamba ndo taŋgine kumig tuku ŋgarosu ta mata kile-tidiŋgamŋgat.
Tira kame, sine taŋgo tuku maŋau gisleknu maŋ dubi ndakube. Nu sine kulat ndakate.
Sine taŋgo tuku maŋau gisleknu kumnemŋge minbe ta sine ŋgisikamŋgig. Sine Tukul Guwa tuku saŋgri mbolŋge ŋgarosu tuku maŋau kile-ibeŋka kume serniŋbe ta sine abo ŋak minamŋgig.
Sine Kuate tuku Guwa tuku nzali dubiweg mbal sine Kuate tuku kiŋo kame mineg.
Sine Tukul Guwa tigeŋ mbal sine piro mbal mayok ka kuru kuru wam mbolŋge pro ndageŋ. Kuga. Sine nu mbolŋge Kuate tuku kiŋo kame mayok ka ndek yiŋe Mam ŋga Kuate wikeg.
Tukul Guwa nu sine sinamŋge tane kumumbi Mam ŋgade ŋga tumsiŋgit le sine Kuate tuku kiŋo kame mineg ta kila pileg.

Sine kiŋo kame mineg ta Mam tuku agaŋ ndende kilam tuku mineg. Kuate nu sine tuku Mam tukunu sine Kristus ndoŋ nuŋe agaŋ ndende ta kilamŋgig. Kile sine ait te mbolŋge nu ndoŋ piti kuraweg ta sine nu ndoŋ kilŋa tamŋgig.
Sine gare suŋgo tamŋgig
Kilŋa suŋgo sine mbolŋge mayok kaŋgat ta ye wam ta idusmba kile piti kuraweg te agaŋ fudiŋndo ŋget.
Kuate nu kilke mbolŋge agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kile-mayokkina ta nane Kuate tuku kiŋo kame mayok kambim tuku ait tairŋga mindesimba minig.

Agaŋ ŋakmba ta maŋau gisleknu mbolŋge pronaig. Nane naŋgine nzali dubimba taŋamba pro ndanaig. Kuate nuŋge nane kilmba maŋau ta kumnemŋge patikina ta nane nduiye taŋamba minmba minam tuku pati ndakina.
Agaŋ kame ŋakmba ta kile ŋaigoŋgam tuku maŋau kumnemŋge minig ta nane Kuate tuku kiŋo kame ndoŋ muskil kile-tidiŋge niŋgamŋgat.
Agaŋ ŋakmba ta pino kiŋo te-palmbim tuku rar kamuste taŋamba muskil te-tiwam tuku mindesimba wikaraumba minig ta sine kila.

Agaŋ kame ta ndo kuga. Sine Tukul Guwa ŋak minmba samba mbolok gare kamuseg mbal sine mata ŋgarosu tuku muskil te-timba Kuate tuku kiŋo kame mayok kambim tuku tairŋga ŋgamuŋgal sinamŋge wikaraumba mineg.
Kuate nu buk muskil kile-tidiŋge siŋgina le kile sine wam ta tuku alonu tairŋga minde mineg. Sine wam ande tairŋga minde mineg le nu prowa sulumba tumail pulusiŋguwa le maŋ nu tairŋge nda.
Sine wam ande tuku tumail pulu ndasiŋgit le sine wamdus saŋgrinu pilmba wam ta ndo tairŋga mineg.

Taŋamba ndo sine saŋgriknu mine ndakeg le Tukul Guwa nu sine sinzaŋsiŋgit. Kuate nu yabaŋ pasa ndaŋ nane kumumbi kade ŋga nzalite ta sine gilai mineg. Tukul Guwa nu sine tuku ŋgamuŋgal sinamŋge Kuate yabaŋam tuku ta sine tuku suŋgomba idusmba pasate fugumba malmbi ndo kate.

Kuate nu taŋgo tuku ŋgamuŋgal ŋakmba kaŋgerte ta nu Tukul Guwa tuku wamdus kila pilit. Tukul Guwa nu Kuate tuku nzali dubimba nu tuku mbal tuku yabaŋte le Kuate nu nuŋe malmbi ndo ismba nu tuku wamdus kila minit.
Sine Kuate tuku kume pureg mbal nu nuŋe wamdus dubimba sine kilam tuku wikina. Wam kame kise kise sine mbolŋge prowe likade ta sine mine mayewam tuku ndo prode ta sine kila.
Kuate nuŋe Kiŋo ta kiŋo mulum minwa ŋga nu o buk sine kilam tuku madisiŋgina ta nuŋe Kiŋo nuŋe tuku maŋau te-purbe ŋga idusna.
Taŋamba nu sine kilam tuku o buk madisiŋgina mbal nu sine wikina. Nu sine wikina sulumba tiŋreknu kile-mayokkina. Sine tiŋreknu kile-mayokkina sulumba nyu sugo siŋgam tuku patikina.
Kuate tuku kume pur maŋau suŋgo
Ye wam kame satiŋgit ta tugunu teŋenmba. Kuate nu sine ndoŋ sailka minwa le imaŋge sine kile-ibeŋkam kumuŋ? Kumuŋ kuga.
Nu nuŋe Kiŋo nuŋe mape ndamba sine tursiŋgam tuku kumwa ŋga pilna. Taŋamba kile nu nuŋe Kiŋo nuŋe mbolŋge wam ŋakmba siŋgit le sine ŋgamuŋgal mukuk ŋak mineg.
Kuate nuŋge sine tiŋreknu ŋgate. Ta tuku ande nu sine Kuateŋge madisiŋgina mbal pasa mbolŋge patikam kumuŋ kuga.

Kristus Yesus nu sinenu ŋga kumna tukunu ande nu sine pa siŋgam tuku mine ndakate. Nu kumna wam ta ndo kuga. Kuate nu te-tina le nu tiŋgina. Kile nu Kuate tuku ndinam kumamŋge minmba sine tuku ŋga Kuate yabaŋmba minit.

Kristus nu sine tuku kume purmba minit ta imaŋge nu tuku kume purte wam ta kuerkam kumuŋ? Piti ait, sinamanzer, afuŋge kasursiŋgig, gubak mineg, agaŋ denkanu mineg, kame agaŋ sine tugum prode, afu balesiŋgam bafude wam kame ta ŋakmba nu tuku kume purte wam ta kuerkam kumuŋ kuga.
Kuyar pasa ande nu teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Sine ne tuku mbal ait ŋakmba kumam tuku mineg.
Sipsip bale faram tuku pileŋgade taŋamba afu sine bale faram tuku pileŋgade ŋgate. Mune 44.22

content: Kristus nu sine tuku suŋgomba kume purte ta nu piti ŋakmba ta kugrakam tuku tursiŋgit le sine saŋgri ŋak mayok kineg.

Ye siŋka son pasa satiŋgamŋgit. Kuate nu siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus mbolŋge sine tuku suŋgomba kume purte ta saŋgri andeŋge nuŋe wamdus ta kuerkam tuku mine ndakate. Sine kumeg e ko abo mineg ta eŋel le guwa sugo sugo tuku saŋgri wam kame kile sine mbolŋge prode ko ŋgumneŋga prowamŋgaig agaŋ ndende samba le kilke mbolŋge mine likade wam kame sakit ta ŋakmbaŋge Kuate nu sine tuku kume purte wamdus ta kuerkam kumuŋ kuga.
